quotes.quote: Repository security advisories allow maintainers of public repositories to privately discuss and fix a security vulnerability in a project.
Privately collaborate to fix the vulnerability in a temporary private fork.
You can give credit to individuals who contributed to a security advisory.
GitHub is a CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) and is authorized to assign CVE identification numbers.
GitHub usually reviews the request within 72 hours.
Requesting a CVE identification number doesn't make your security advisory public.
GitHub cannot assign CVEs to your project if it is covered by another CNA.
Anyone can see the current version of the advisory data, as well as any advisory credits that the credited users have accepted.
you should add a fix version to a security advisory prior to publishing the advisory
